learner_operation: Identify every non-pivot column of a supplied row echelon form matrix. Scan the first nonzero entry of each nonzero row and take the complement of their column indices.

fixed_features.feature: Matrix already in row echelon form; small integer entries and observed shapes.
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial Introduction defines pivots as first nonzero entries; source KP precedes the separate general-matrix elimination KP. Keep scanning workload comparable.

fixed_features.feature: One checkbox per column, complete true/false bank, one or two selected columns.
fixed_features.justification: All 17 source questions use this contract. One or two non-pivots supports complement classification without expanding workload to zero matrices/full rank cases.

fixed_features.feature: Displayed columns are in natural numeric order.
fixed_features.justification: Column numbering identifies matrix positions. Position is not held correct; every eligible non-pivot assignment for each shape/rank is covered.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Move leading entries while preserving increasing pivot positions and zero rows last; choose eligible rank/shape.
answer_roles.observed: 58 explicit structures, all retained in the maximal generated batch; fresh samples and delivered batch cover different leading positions.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Every eligible column index can be non-pivot; one and two selections, leading/interior/trailing and nonzero non-pivot vectors.
answer_roles.observed: Five delivered batch subsets are {1,5}, {4,5}, {1}, {1,2}, {2}; full structural controls cover each eligible subset.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change A/B/P/R and signs/magnitudes without changing membership unless a first-nonzero position changes.
answer_roles.observed: Conditional label/shape probes retained; controlled irrelevant coefficient edit preserves membership and grader outcomes.

coverage.case: All supplied source cases, including complete Boolean banks.
coverage.result: 17/17 match source prompts, solutions and complete labelled banks after whitespace normalization.

coverage.case: Eligible shape/rank/pivot-position cases and coefficient boundaries.
coverage.result: 58 cases with entries at -9,0,9; all REF and correct complements; batch of 58 reaches all structures after 304 proposals.

coverage.case: Fresh generation and exact delivered runner batch.
coverage.result: 120/120 fresh and 5/5 exact batch records survive shared delivery; tested decision distributions unchanged. Batch has five distinct correct subsets.

counterfactuals.change: In the same 3x4 matrix change a22 from 3 to 0, shifting row 2 pivot from column 2 to 3.
counterfactuals.expected: Selected columns change from {3,4} to {2,4}. Prompt, vectors, explanation and native checkbox grading must follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Both matrices and explanations agree; native grader accepts new membership and rejects the old column-2/3 actions; actual UI screenshots show changed row 2 and selected fields.
counterfactuals.justification: First nonzero position determines pivot membership by the lesson definition.

counterfactuals.change: Hold pivots fixed; change a12 from 4 to -9.
counterfactuals.expected: Selected columns stay {3,4}; prompt, vector and solution matrix reflect the changed coefficient.
counterfactuals.observed: Membership is unchanged; both native Boolean actions per field give the same acceptance pattern, and rendered changed vector/matrix retain the same selection and conclusion.
counterfactuals.justification: An entry to the right of an existing leading entry does not alter first-nonzero columns.

stages_examined: captured easy-only weighted learner selection and representative history exclusions
delivery.result: Every tested structure is reachable. All 120 fresh and five runner records survive normalization and captured-inventory deduplication. Easy-positive within-band selection retains reachability under tested histories; unconfigured selection deterministically picks first eligible ID. No perfect repeated fixed-subset cue by label or shape was found. Zero-column simplification follows the taught definition and does not answer all batch records.

limitations: Finite tests do not prove absence of every shortcut. Small batch singleton cue groups cannot establish a systematic predictor.
Inventory and deduplication conclusions are based on captured basis 5362; concurrent inventory changes are outside this read-only review.
Active learner history/policy was not supplied; selection is a faithful conditional simulation with actual captured IDs, not a live session.
No diagrams or external assets occur. Free-entry equivalent-notation tests are inapplicable because every field is a Boolean checkbox; both real UI actions were tested.
